title: Phone speaks updates without long pauses

requirements.text: The phone starts speaking an update within about a second of its text showing on the car's dashboard, and moves to the next update with no gap of several seconds
requirements.check: TJ hears a walk-through of two or more updates in the car without the roughly eight-second wait he reported

text: Cause: the phone waits up to 8s (Walker WAIT_MS) for each item's first Genlock clip, then falls back; clips were late because the speaker loaded a fresh engine per project voice (5-10s, LRU of 2 thrashed), exited after 30 idle min (cold start), and the old bridge client killed speakers with other code. Fixed in speaker.mjs + Walker 5s + Mac app warms speaker. Warm 6-item test: first clip 2.2s, next item ~1.5-2s after previous done. Waiting on T-22V2Z for bridge restart + APK install.

Evidence from TJ on the old build+bridge: first update came in the new natural voice, every later one in the phone's robotic built-in voice. Matches the cause: later items needed new per-project engine loads (5-10s) and missed the phone's 8s wait, so it fell back. Next: once T-22V2Z installs the new APK and restarts the bridge, check a multi-item walk gets clips for every item.

Live: speaker client spawned duplicate speakers whenever one was slow (Mac swapping, 8.7/9.2GB) - a spiral; fixed: single-instance speaker, clients wait for a live one (node + Swift), replaced speakers exit within 60s. One speaker now (39925, current code). Under memory pressure first clips took 29-57s; after stopping my Gradle daemon a 2-sentence request takes ~12-14s. Two old orphan speakers (41987, 53706, ~1.8GB) kill was denied. Bridge still runs pre-fix client: needs one more restart. APK only on R2 link, not on Pixel yet.

why: one line per clip: queued, load, make time, audio seconds, rss, swap

text: Logged per clip (~/.genlock/voice/speaker.log). Three causes: (1) swap: synthesis 3-4x slower than audio, every item past the 5s wait; (2) shared queue: Mac app readings queued phone items up to 11.7s; (3) speaker retiring on a code change dropped queued requests (bridge 18:30:44 fetch failed -> whole item robotic). Fixed 2+3: sentence round robin; retire only when idle and start the replacement. Live: 3 concurrent asks + code change: all done, first clips 6.1/7.5/8.6s. Phone walk not re-heard by TJ yet.

Phone voices on device now (0.53-0.58x realtime), so causes 1-3 are bypassed on the phone. New pause: T-7B3SF's tone wait adds 1.27-1.6s before each item after a mic session. Next: shorten that (e.g. start the clip as soon as speaker-safe clears) and time a walk.
